source_snapshot.procedure: Move Clear-CMOS switch to alternate side, power on and inspect jumper-function page; restore.
source_snapshot.criteria: Powers on in alternate position; switch functions; restored system does not hang or log error.
source_snapshot.deepseek: NO; human physical jumper and BIOS observation.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: MANUAL ONLY/HIGH; exact switch, ESD/power-off, configuration backup and restore verification.

historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Adds safe handling and configuration recovery.
historical_reviews.v3_1: ED-02/05/06 require switch/default/log oracle; ED-04/07/08 require physical/recovery controls; ED-36/38 reserve verdict.

original_test_intent: Verify the designated Clear-CMOS switch position is detected and allows the specified service-page behavior, then restore normal position and prove clean boot/configuration recovery.
original_method: Back up BIOS settings and identify exact board/switch positions; fully power down and discharge per vendor procedure; qualified operator uses ESD controls to move switch; power on only as vendor-authorized and capture the expected page/message; power down, restore original position, boot, compare settings and logs, and recover any approved defaults.
manual_activity: Qualified operator identifies and moves/restores the physical switch under vendor power/ESD procedure; agent may collect read-only firmware, boot and log evidence.
required_inputs: Board revision and Clear-CMOS switch designator/position map
Vendor power-off/discharge and allowed power-on sequence
Expected jumper-function page/message and CMOS configuration effects
BIOS backup/restore, recovery access and final-state baseline
safety_requirements: De-energize/discharge and use ESD controls before touching board
Confirm exact switch and photograph initial/alternate/final position
Protect boot/storage/security configuration and preserve recovery console
Stop on wrong control, damage, boot failure or inability to restore; no automatic retry
agent_execution_scope: Collect configuration, page/photo metadata, boot and log evidence
Compare pre/post BIOS values and platform health after operator action
Do not touch hardware, clear logs, power on in an unapproved switch state, restore by guesswork or decide verdict
engineer_actions: Approve switch map and safe power sequence
Approve expected service indication and CMOS reset/default effects
Review evidence and decide PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: No command can substitute for moving and visually identifying the physical Clear-CMOS switch.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use read-only BIOS inventory and boot/log capture only around the operator-controlled hardware procedure.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Alternate switch position, power-on/service-page check, original-position restore and clean-boot/log criteria remain.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a board-revision-specific position map, photo evidence and a powered-down move/restore sequence with configuration diff and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds exact identity, electrical safety, expected page/default behavior and final-state verification.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A successful power-on alone does not prove the switch function or acceptable CMOS configuration impact.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Some platforms prohibit applying power in the clear position or reset security/storage settings; vendor sequence is authoritative.

project_override_considerations: If the switch is momentary or intended only while power is removed, do not follow the literal power-on step until engineering reconciles it with the board procedure.
expected_evidence: Pre/post BIOS configuration diff plus logs and health

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure and Criteria consistently cover alternate-position function and restored clean boot; wording is poor but not contradictory.

blocked_analysis.analysis: This is a valid manual physical test once the platform procedure and qualified operator are available.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Functionality row 2261 Wistron-HW-00180-V003: approve board revision, Clear-CMOS switch designator and original/alternate positions; vendor power-off/discharge and whether power-on in the alternate position is permitted; expected jumper-function page/message and exact CMOS/default/configuration effects; approve BIOS backup/restore, storage/security recovery, ESD/operator controls, log oracle and final restored state.

review_improvement: Keeps the physical switch coverage while preventing live or wrong-jumper manipulation and requiring proof of both function and recovery.
independent_technical_reasoning: Clear-CMOS controls differ: a maintained switch may be sampled at boot, while a jumper may only be safe unpowered. Clearing CMOS can change boot order, storage mode, Secure Boot and other settings even if the system powers on. Therefore execution must follow the exact board procedure and acceptance must include the intended service indication, configuration delta and restored normal boot—not merely absence of a hang.
